concepts.preferred_label: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 Pneumonia
concepts.why: The patient has a confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and bilateral ground-glass opacities with lower-lung predominance on chest CT, consistent with COVID-19 pneumonia.
The patient has elevated WBC, CRP, and APTT, which are consistent with disseminated intravascular coagulation, a known complication of severe COVID-19.
The patient developed pneumonia while intubated, as evidenced by the initiation of cefepime, which is consistent with ventilator-associated pneumonia.
The patient has a high fever, elevated WBC, and CRP, which are consistent with sepsis, a life-threatening condition that can occur in response to an infection.
The patient has diffuse edema of the intestine and is on continuous renal replacement therapy, which is consistent with acute kidney injury, a known complication of sepsis and COVID-19.
The patient has an elevated APTT, which can be associated with thrombocytopenia, a condition characterized by a low platelet count.
The patient requires intubation and mechanical ventilation, which is consistent with respiratory failure, a life-threatening condition that can occur in response to severe COVID-19 pneumonia.
The patient has hypotension, tachycardia, and hypothermia, which are consistent with septic shock, a life-threatening condition that can occur in response to an infection.

The patient has bilateral ground-glass opacities with lower-lung predominance on chest CT, which is consistent with acute respiratory distress syndrome, a life-threatening condition that can occur in response to severe COVID-19 pneumonia.

The patient has evidence of multiple organ dysfunction, including respiratory failure, acute kidney injury, and coagulopathy, which is consistent with multiple organ dysfunction syndrome, a life-threatening condition that can occur in response to sepsis and COVID-19.

rationales.F12: The prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time is consistent with coagulopathy, which could be related to C02.
